tool_schemas.name: ask_human
tool_schemas.description: Ask your human principal a question, or request approval for one specific action before taking it (give action_tool and action_args). Humans are slow and costly: ask only when you genuinely need their knowledge or authority.

action_tool.description: Tool you want approval to call (optional).

args.question: I couldn't find any past reservations for Dana Lee, so I don't know the "usual hotel" in New York. Available options for check-in 2026-11-12 (2 nights): H1 Midtown Lodge ($189/night, $378 total), H2 Harbor Inn ($239/night, $478 total), H3 Plaza Grand ($459/night, $918 total). Which hotel should I book? Also, the flight will be F100 (SFO→JFK nonstop, $289), bringing the cheapest combo total to $667 — under $1000, so no manager approval is needed unless you prefer a pricier hotel.
